description: The sandbox itself: which agent runs, and which of the sessions' ports are published.

settings.label: Agent
settings.description: Which CLI agent runs in the sandbox.

settings.label: Agent version
settings.description: Pins the agent CLI's version. Empty: the latest release, checked on every run.

settings.label: Ports to publish
settings.description: Space-separated ports the sandbox opens: a server listening on one is published on this machine and shown on its session. Empty: none.

settings.label: Publish ports on
settings.description: Address the sessions' ports are published on; 0.0.0.0 for your whole network.
